title: Real-Life: Train tickets
situation: You want to travel to Westford tomorrow morning and return the same evening. You want to spend as little money as possible. You hear the following announcement at the station.
script: Narrator: Attention, passengers. A one-way ticket to Westford costs twenty dollars, and a round-trip ticket costs thirty-five dollars. However, if you travel after nine thirty a.m. on weekdays, you can buy an off-peak round-trip ticket for just twenty-five dollars. Please note that off-peak tickets cannot be used on trains returning between five and seven p.m. Passengers who hold a rail card can also receive an additional ten percent discount on all tickets.
translation: 乗客の皆さまにお知らせします。ウェストフォードまでの片道切符は20ドル、往復切符は35ドルです。ただし平日の午前9時半以降にご乗車の場合は、オフピーク往復切符をわずか25ドルでお買い求めいただけます。オフピーク切符は午後5時から7時の間の帰りの列車ではご利用になれませんのでご注意ください。レールカードをお持ちの方は、すべての切符がさらに10%割引になります。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy an off-peak ticket and return after seven p.m.
Buy two one-way tickets.
Buy a regular round-trip ticket.
Leave before nine thirty a.m. and return at six p.m.
questions.explanation: 最も安いのは25ドルのオフピーク往復切符。9時半以降に出発し、使えない午後5〜7時を避けて7時以降に帰れば同日往復できる。

title: Real-Life: Museum tour
situation: You are visiting a museum with your eight-year-old son. You want to join a guided tour that he will enjoy. You hear the following announcement.
script: Narrator: Welcome to the City History Museum. Today we are offering several guided tours. At eleven, there is a tour of our ancient pottery collection, which is recommended for adults with a strong interest in archaeology. At one o'clock, we have a family tour of the dinosaur hall, which includes hands-on activities for children aged six to twelve. At two thirty, there is a tour of our new photography exhibition. Tours are free, but please register at the information desk at least fifteen minutes before the start time.
translation: 市立歴史博物館へようこそ。本日はいくつかのガイドツアーをご用意しています。11時は古代の陶器コレクションのツアーで、考古学に強い関心のある大人の方におすすめです。1時は恐竜ホールのファミリーツアーで、6歳から12歳のお子さま向けの体験活動があります。2時半は新しい写真展のツアーです。ツアーは無料ですが、開始の15分前までに案内所でお申し込みください。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the dinosaur hall at eleven.
Join the pottery tour at eleven.
Register for the photography tour by 2:15.
Register at the information desk by 12:45.
questions.explanation: 8歳の息子に合うのは6〜12歳向けの1時の恐竜ファミリーツアー。開始15分前までに案内所で申し込む必要があるので12時45分までに登録する。

title: Real-Life: Phone repair
situation: Your smartphone screen is cracked. You bought the phone eight months ago, and you need it back as soon as possible. You call the store and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Mobile Plus. For screen repairs, we offer two options. If your phone is under one year old, the repair is covered by the manufacturer's warranty, but the phone must be sent to the service center, and the repair takes about one week. Alternatively, our in-store technicians can replace your screen within two hours for a fee of one hundred and twenty dollars. No appointment is necessary for in-store repairs; simply bring your phone to any of our branches.
translation: モバイルプラスにお電話いただきありがとうございます。画面の修理には2つの方法がございます。購入から1年未満の端末はメーカー保証で修理できますが、サービスセンターへの発送が必要で、修理に約1週間かかります。または、店内の技術者が120ドルの料金で2時間以内に画面を交換いたします。店内修理は予約不要です。お近くの支店に端末をお持ちください。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take your phone to one of the store's branches.
Send your phone to the service center.
Make an appointment for an in-store repair.
Contact the manufacturer directly.
questions.explanation: できるだけ早く必要なので、1週間かかる保証修理ではなく2時間で終わる店内修理を選ぶ。予約不要で支店に持ち込めばよい。

title: Real-Life: Apartment heating
situation: The heater in your apartment has stopped working. It is Saturday evening. You call the building management office and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: You have reached the management office of Greenview Apartments. Our office is open from nine to five, Monday through Friday. For general questions, please leave a message, and we will return your call on the next business day. If you are experiencing an emergency, such as a water leak, a gas smell, or a heating failure during the winter months, please call our twenty-four-hour maintenance line at 555-0199. For fire or medical emergencies, call 911 immediately.
translation: グリーンビュー・アパートメントの管理事務所です。事務所の受付時間は月曜から金曜の9時から5時です。一般的なお問い合わせはメッセージを残してください。翌営業日に折り返しお電話します。水漏れ、ガス臭、冬季の暖房の故障などの緊急の場合は、24時間対応の保守窓口 555-0199 にお電話ください。火災や急病の場合は、すぐに911に通報してください。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Call the twenty-four-hour maintenance line.
Leave a message for the management office.
Call the office again on Monday morning.
Call 911 immediately.
questions.explanation: 土曜の夜で事務所は閉まっているが、冬の暖房の故障は緊急扱いなので24時間対応の保守窓口に電話する。

title: Real-Life: Gym membership
situation: You want to join a gym. You can only exercise on weekends, and you want to use the swimming pool. You hear the following explanation from a staff member.
script: Narrator: We have four types of membership. The basic plan costs thirty dollars a month and allows you to use the gym equipment on weekdays only. The weekend plan costs twenty-five dollars and gives you access to the gym on Saturdays and Sundays, but it doesn't include the pool. The standard plan, at fifty dollars, includes the gym and pool every day. Finally, the premium plan, at seventy dollars, includes everything in the standard plan plus unlimited fitness classes.
translation: 会員には4種類あります。ベーシックプランは月30ドルで、平日のみジムの器具を使えます。週末プランは25ドルで土日にジムを使えますが、プールは含まれません。スタンダードプランは50ドルで、毎日ジムとプールを使えます。最後に、プレミアムプランは70ドルで、スタンダードの内容に加えてフィットネスクラスが受け放題です。

questions.question: Which plan should you choose?
choices: The weekend plan.
The basic plan.
The premium plan.
The standard plan.
questions.explanation: 週末にプールを使いたい。週末プランはプールなし、ベーシックは平日のみ。プールを含む最も安いのはスタンダードプラン。フィットネスクラスは必要ないのでプレミアムは不要。

title: Real-Life: Package delivery
situation: You missed a package delivery today. You will be at work tomorrow from eight a.m. to six p.m. You call the delivery company and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Swift Delivery. If you missed a delivery, you have several options. We can try to deliver your package again tomorrow between nine a.m. and five p.m. If this time is not convenient, you can pick up your package at our local depot, which is open until nine p.m. on weekdays. You can also have the package sent to a convenience store near your home, but this service takes two additional days. To choose an option, please enter your tracking number now.
translation: スウィフト配送にお電話いただきありがとうございます。配達を受け取れなかった場合は、いくつかの方法がございます。明日の午前9時から午後5時の間に再配達できます。この時間が不都合な場合は、平日午後9時まで営業している地域の営業所でお受け取りいただけます。ご自宅近くのコンビニへの転送もできますが、この場合はさらに2日かかります。方法を選ぶには、追跡番号を入力してください。

questions.question: What should you do to get your package as soon as possible?
choices: Pick it up at the local depot after work tomorrow.
Ask for redelivery tomorrow afternoon.
Have it sent to a convenience store.
Wait until the weekend for redelivery.
questions.explanation: 明日は8時から6時まで仕事なので9〜5時の再配達は受け取れない。コンビニ転送は2日余計にかかる。午後9時まで開いている営業所に仕事帰りに取りに行くのが最も早い。

title: Real-Life: Conference sessions
situation: You are attending a business conference. You want to learn about marketing on social media, and you must leave the conference by three p.m. You hear the following announcement.
script: Narrator: Good morning, everyone. Here are this afternoon's sessions. At one o'clock in Room A, Ms. Harris will speak about building a strong brand through traditional advertising. At the same time in Room B, there will be a panel discussion on international trade. At two o'clock in Room C, Mr. Patel will give a workshop on using social media to reach new customers. Please note that this workshop will last ninety minutes. The same social media workshop will be repeated tomorrow morning at ten in Room A.
translation: 皆さま、おはようございます。本日午後のセッションをご案内します。1時からA室で、ハリス氏が従来型広告による強いブランド作りについて講演します。同じ時間にB室では国際貿易に関するパネル討論があります。2時からC室で、パテル氏が新しい顧客を獲得するためのSNS活用ワークショップを行います。このワークショップは90分間ですのでご注意ください。同じSNSのワークショップは明日午前10時からA室でも行われます。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to Room C at two o'clock today.
Attend the workshop in Room A tomorrow morning.
Attend Ms. Harris's talk at one o'clock.
Join the panel discussion in Room B.
questions.explanation: SNSのワークショップは今日2時から90分で、3時までに出なければならないので最後まで受けられない。明日10時の同じワークショップに出ればよい。

title: Real-Life: Library books
situation: You borrowed three books from the library, and they are due today. You have finished two of them, but you want to keep the third one for another week. You hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Welcome to the Riverside Public Library information line. Books can be borrowed for two weeks. You can renew a book once for an additional two weeks, as long as no other member has reserved it. Renewals can be made online, by phone, or at the front desk. Please note that books that have been reserved by another member cannot be renewed and must be returned by the due date. Late returns are charged at fifty cents per book per day.
translation: リバーサイド公立図書館の案内電話です。本の貸出期間は2週間です。ほかの会員が予約していなければ、1回に限りさらに2週間延長できます。延長はオンライン、電話、カウンターで受け付けます。ほかの会員が予約している本は延長できず、返却期限までに返さなければなりませんのでご注意ください。返却が遅れた場合は1冊につき1日50セントかかります。

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Return all three books today.
Keep the book and pay the late fee.
Check whether the third book has been reserved by someone else.
Borrow the book again next week.
questions.explanation: 延長できるのはほかの会員が予約していない場合だけなので、まず3冊目が予約されていないか確認する必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Volunteer work
situation: You want to do volunteer work at an animal shelter. You are available on Saturday mornings, and you have no experience with animals. You hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for your interest in volunteering at Happy Paws Animal Shelter. We have several roles available. Dog walkers are needed on weekday afternoons, and previous experience with large dogs is required. Volunteers for our cat care team work on Saturday and Sunday mornings, and no experience is needed, but all new volunteers must attend a one-hour orientation session first. Orientation sessions are held on the first Saturday of every month. To sign up, please visit our website.
translation: ハッピーパウズ動物保護施設のボランティアにご関心をお寄せいただきありがとうございます。いくつかの役割がございます。犬の散歩係は平日の午後に募集しており、大型犬の扱いの経験が必要です。猫の世話チームのボランティアは土日の午前に活動し、経験は不要ですが、新しいボランティアは全員、まず1時間のオリエンテーションに参加しなければなりません。オリエンテーションは毎月第1土曜日に行われます。お申し込みはウェブサイトからどうぞ。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply to be a dog walker.
Go to the shelter next Saturday to care for cats.
Sign up for an orientation session on the website.
Gain experience with large dogs first.
questions.explanation: 土曜の午前に活動でき経験不要なのは猫の世話チーム。ただし新人はまずオリエンテーションに出る必要があり、申し込みはウェブサイトから。

title: Real-Life: Hotel check-out
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves at eight p.m., and you want to go sightseeing after checking out. You hear the following information from the front desk.
script: Narrator: Check-out time is eleven a.m. If you need a later check-out, we can extend it until two p.m. for an additional fee of thirty dollars, depending on availability. After checking out, guests are welcome to leave their luggage with us free of charge until midnight. We also offer an airport shuttle bus, which leaves from the front entrance every hour. The trip to the airport takes about forty-five minutes, so we recommend taking the bus at least three hours before your flight.
translation: チェックアウトは午前11時です。遅いチェックアウトをご希望の場合は、空き状況によって追加料金30ドルで午後2時まで延長できます。チェックアウト後は、深夜0時までお荷物を無料でお預かりします。また、正面玄関から1時間ごとに空港シャトルバスが出ています。空港まで約45分かかりますので、フライトの少なくとも3時間前のバスのご利用をおすすめします。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay for a late check-out until two p.m.
Take your luggage with you while sightseeing.
Leave your luggage at the hotel and take the shuttle by five p.m.
Take the shuttle bus at seven p.m.
questions.explanation: チェックアウト後に荷物を無料で預けて観光でき、8時の便の3時間前、つまり午後5時までにシャトルに乗ればよい。7時では遅すぎる。

title: Real-Life: Cooking class
situation: You want to take a cooking class to learn how to make healthy meals. You are a beginner and can only attend on weekday evenings. You hear the following information.
script: Narrator: Our cooking school offers several courses this month. On Tuesday evenings, we have an advanced French cuisine class for experienced cooks. On Wednesday evenings, there is a beginners' course called Healthy Home Cooking, which teaches simple, low-calorie recipes. On Saturday mornings, we offer a baking class for all levels. Please note that the Wednesday course is very popular and only has a few places left, so we recommend booking online as soon as possible.
translation: 当料理教室では今月いくつかのコースがございます。火曜の夜は経験者向けの上級フランス料理クラスです。水曜の夜は初心者向けの「ヘルシー家庭料理」コースで、簡単で低カロリーのレシピを教えます。土曜の午前はすべてのレベル向けのパン・お菓子作りクラスです。水曜のコースは大変人気で残りわずかですので、できるだけ早くオンラインでのご予約をおすすめします。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Sign up for the Tuesday evening class.
Join the Saturday baking class.
Visit the school on Wednesday to register.
Book the Wednesday course online soon.
questions.explanation: 初心者で平日の夜しか出られず健康的な料理を学びたいので水曜の夜のコース。残りわずかなので早くオンラインで予約する。

title: Real-Life: Bicycle rental
situation: You are visiting a city for one day and want to rent a bicycle for about five hours. You do not have a credit card. You hear the following explanation at a rental shop.
script: Narrator: We offer bicycles for rent by the hour or by the day. Hourly rentals cost five dollars per hour, and day rentals cost twenty dollars. All rentals require a deposit. If you pay by credit card, we just need to keep your card details. If you pay in cash, we ask for a fifty-dollar deposit, which will be returned when you bring the bicycle back. Please note that day rentals must be returned by six p.m. Helmets are available free of charge.
translation: 自転車は時間単位または1日単位でお貸ししています。時間貸しは1時間5ドル、1日貸しは20ドルです。すべてのレンタルに保証金が必要です。クレジットカードでお支払いの場合はカード情報をお預かりするだけです。現金でお支払いの場合は50ドルの保証金をお預かりし、自転車を返却したときにお返しします。1日貸しは午後6時までにご返却ください。ヘルメットは無料でお貸しします。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay five dollars per hour and give your card details.
Pay twenty dollars for a day rental and a fifty-dollar cash deposit.
Rent a bicycle for five hours with no deposit.
Pay twenty-five dollars for an hourly rental with no deposit.
questions.explanation: 5時間の時間貸しは25ドル、1日貸しは20ドルなので1日貸しが安い。カードがないので現金で50ドルの保証金を払う必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Doctor's appointment
situation: You have had a high fever since last night, and you want to see a doctor today. You call a clinic and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Maple Street Clinic. Our regular appointments are fully booked for this week. If you have a fever or cold symptoms, please do not come to the waiting room directly. Instead, we offer same-day online consultations with our doctors from two to five p.m. You can book these consultations through our website. If you have difficulty breathing or severe chest pain, please go to the emergency room at City Hospital.
translation: メープル通りクリニックにお電話いただきありがとうございます。今週の通常の予約はすべて埋まっております。発熱や風邪の症状がある方は、待合室に直接来ないでください。代わりに、午後2時から5時まで、医師による当日のオンライン診療を行っております。オンライン診療はウェブサイトから予約できます。呼吸が苦しい場合や激しい胸の痛みがある場合は、市立病院の救急外来に行ってください。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the clinic's waiting room this afternoon.
Book an online consultation through the website.
Make a regular appointment for next week.
Go to the emergency room at City Hospital.
questions.explanation: 今日受診したいが通常予約は満員で、発熱があるので待合室に直接行ってはいけない。当日のオンライン診療をウェブサイトで予約する。呼吸困難などはないので救急は不要。
